title: #57 - I Can Beat Him Too
content:
#57 - I Can Beat Him Too

Chapter 57 I can fight too

Desmond thought he knew Arthur's fighting ability before, but he was still deeply shocked by the scene he saw.

The tables and chairs in the tavern were affected by the fight and were in a mess.

Arthur, who was at the center of the battle, hit a small piece of trash with one punch. In a few breaths, all the twenty people brought by Creo fell to the ground, rolling over and over and screaming.

Desmond even saw a few followers who were not hit by the punches. Seeing that the situation was not right, they fell to the ground and groaned.

"Seven Gods!" Patrick exclaimed loudly, "I didn't have time to make a move."

He also stood up to meet the enemy, thinking that he could show off his skills in front of Arthur, but he didn't even touch the enemy's body.

There were not many people with weapons among the more than 20 people on the opposite side. I think most of them were gangsters, hooligans, etc. The few who had swords were knocked down by Arthur in the first time.

There was even a sword with a fist mark on the blade of the sword hit by Arthur's fist.

Patrick looked at the fist mark and marveled.

Arthur felt his companions' eyes on him, so he shook his hands and said with a smile: "It hurts!"

In fact, he didn't feel much pain, probably because of the Iron Bone skill. As long as there was no bloody collision, the pain was greatly reduced.

After hitting the people on the ground a few times to ensure that they would not suddenly attack from behind, Arthur looked at the few golden robes who were slowly walking over.

The captain in the lead suddenly felt fortunate that he moved slowly, otherwise he and his subordinates would also be lying on the ground at this moment.

This man is too strong!

"We are here to persuade and stop the fight." The captain hurriedly shook his hand and denied that he was in the same group with Cleos.

Then he pretended to be righteous and said: "Sir Cleos, your act of instructing people to beat people is not in accordance with King Robert's law. I suggest you go to the throne room of the Red Castle and confess your guilt to the king or the prime minister."

The meaning of his words was to let Cleos run quickly.

Otherwise, he might be beaten like his drunken cousin.

He turned his head and saw Clio's eyes were dull and his mouth was wide open, as if he had seen a white walker.

"Impossible, absolutely impossible." Clio kept muttering, "Even if it was the Mountain, it would be impossible for him to defeat so many people so quickly."

"How can the Mountain compare to me?" Arthur boasted, then strode forward and walked to Clio and his cousin.

The two were deeply shocked by Arthur's bravery and had no idea of running away.

In fact, their legs had begun to tremble, but they themselves did not react because of fear.

Arthur grabbed one person's neck with one hand and threw them hard, knocking their heads onto the table next to him.

"Sir, don't fight anymore, this is the queen's cousin." A spectator reminded.

"That's right, Cersei's cousin is not someone you, a country noble, can fight."

"Get away if you get the upper hand, don't let the gold cloaks arrest you."

Arthur glared at the chattering spectators fiercely, "He is the king of the world, and I can beat him if he falls into my hands, not to mention that he is just a relative of the queen."

"Well said, beat them up." Patrick cheered for his idol on the side.

Yes, from this moment on, he decided to change his idol from Arthur Dayne, the Sword of the Gods, to Arthur Bracken.

The Sword of the Gods only exists in legends, but Bracken is a record of seeing and hearing.

Arthur turned his head and ignored the spectators.

"Let's talk about you first. If you hadn't been so naughty and touched that girl, and then acted so coquettishly that I couldn't stand it, would I have been able to punish you?"

Arthur pressed Cleos's cousin's head on the table and banged it hard for more than a dozen times, and stopped only when he felt that he had let out a breath.

"Besides, you came here to extort a thousand gold royals. Do you think I can't hear it? If I don't teach you a lesson, do you think I'm easy to bully?"

Arthur hated extortionists the most. After giving Cleo and his cousin the same treatment, he let them go.

Their foreheads were bleeding. After being released, they sat on the ground.

They didn't dare to leave, and they couldn't leave.

Because their legs were shaking so much from fear that they couldn't stand up.

The captain of the gold robes looked at this scene very awkwardly. According to his duty, he should stop it, but he didn't dare to get too close to him after seeing the man's fighting power.

While he was embarrassed, he caught a glimpse of his superiors outside the tavern with a large group of gold robes.

"What are we going to do next?" Patrick asked excitedly.

"Of course, we're leaving." Arthur waved his hand, signaling his companions to run away.

But more gold robes rushed over and blocked the door.

"You dare to hit someone in King's Landing, you are so brave!" The leader shouted loudly to establish his authority.

Then he saw the purple-bottomed silver eagle embroidered on Patrick's collar.

"Oh, it turns out to be the Lord of Sealand City. Are you not injured?" He immediately became amiable.

Patrick was still young and didn't know how to deal with it, so he raised his proud chin and remained silent.

Desmond was mature and immediately went up to explain.

The leader of the golden robes saw this scene, and also glimpsed the queen's cousin Cleos lying on the ground, and then saw the embarrassed look of his captain, and immediately understood the general situation.

It seemed that two groups of nobles were fighting, and his men didn't dare to stop them.

He rolled his eyes and immediately had a way to deal with it.

Let King Robert make the judgment.

Unlike the madness of the late King Aerys II, King Robert was an extremely peaceful ruler.

Even the noble families that were enemies of him in the War of the Usurper could retain their territories as long as they swore to submit to him.

At most, they would be reduced in titles and titles.

This was also the reason why he quickly established a unified kingdom in the Seven Kingdoms.

The leader of the golden robes first made a round, "Your subordinates are really good at fighting. They actually defeated opponents who were several times their own."

He said to Patrick, but he didn't see that Arthur was the core of this group.

"This matter has made a big fuss. I dare not make a judgment. Why don't we move to the Red Castle and let the king make the judgment in the throne room?"

Although he spoke in a tone of suggestion, he had already ordered his men to help up the people who fell to the ground, arrested the couple and the girl in the tavern, and surrounded Arthur and others.

It seems that not going to the Red Castle is not an option.

Patrick looked at Arthur, and after getting the idol's consent, he nodded, indicating that he agreed to go to the Red Castle to listen to the king's judgment.

The group went to the throne room.

The idle people, wandering warriors, and small nobles who heard the news gradually joined in.

When they arrived at the gate of the Red Castle, hundreds of people gathered.

The throne room is the hall where the symbol of the king of Westeros, the Iron Throne, is located.

Because it is the place where the king listens to the complaints of the people and announces the judgment, the throne room sometimes allows civilians to enter.

So the golden robes, Arthur and other victims and hundreds of civilian nobles who were watching rushed in together.
